title: 10 Things a Godly Man Stops Faking in Small Group
caption:
Small group can be the most honest room in your week. Or it can be ninety minutes of everybody saying they're good.

The unspoken request. "I've been in the Word." The sin from two years ago that's safe to share now. "Things are good, man." We all know the script.

Brothers can't fight a war you won't report. Name the actual thing. Ask the follow-up. Stay for the driveway conversation.

"Confess your sins to one another and pray for one another, that you may be healed." James 5:16

Save this before Tuesday night. Send it to the guys in your group.
